channel.title: Blockheight
channel.description: Blockheight reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: Liquidity position: a lower APR alone is no reason to exit
item.description: Should I exit my liquidity position when the APR drops? Exit only when lower expected fees lose to a better option after exit and re-entry costs over your holding period.

item.title: Smart Contract Cross-Chain Messages: Celer’s Receiver Checks
item.description: A smart contract receives a cross-chain message through MessageBus signature checks, then verifies the source chain and sender before acting on the payload.

item.title: How much collateral is needed for a crypto loan? Estimate yours
item.description: How much collateral is needed for a crypto loan? Divide the loan by its LTV for the minimum value, then add a buffer for price moves and growing debt.

item.title: CoW Swap order UID: digest, owner and expiry
item.description: What is inside a DEX order UID? CoW Swap packs a 32-byte EIP-712 digest, 20-byte owner address and 4-byte validTo expiry into 56 bytes.

item.title: TWAMM long-term order: Choose a window that meets your deadline
item.description: Choose a TWAMM long-term order duration by dividing order size by hours, comparing that rate with normal pair volume, then checking your deadline.

item.title: How to Verify a Bridge Spender Address Before Approving Tokens
item.description: How to verify a bridge spender address before approving tokens: match the route’s approval address to your wallet prompt and confirm it on the source-chain explorer.

item.title: DOJ seeks forfeiture of $1.17B in USDC tied to Binance hack
item.description: The Justice Department seeks forfeiture of more than $1.1 billion in USDC linked to the Binance hack, with Circle offering replacement tokens if a court orders it.

item.title: What Each Bridge Prompt Authorizes
item.description: What each wallet signature means when bridging tokens: connect, network, approval, transaction and claim prompts—and the spending power each one grants.

item.title: When do intent orders beat a DEX aggregator?
item.description: For large, MEV-exposed trades or patient limit and TWAP orders, choose intent trading; use a DEX aggregator when execution must be immediate, atomic or available on that chain.

item.title: Hashi launches on Sui with hBTC lending live
item.description: Hashi went live on Sui on Nov. 19, issuing 1:1 hBTC against Bitcoin for collateral use; Fluid opened USDC borrowing, with more integrations planned.

item.title: Bitcoin Slides Below $59,000, Then Rebounds From $55,130
item.description: Bitcoin fell below $59,000 on Nov. 20 and later hit $55,130 as stock losses and rate fears deepened selling; it rebounded above $61,000 Monday.

item.title: Bitcoin falls below $59,000 as traders seek cash
item.description: Bitcoin fell below $59,000 on Nov. 20, nearing its summer low as strategists cited thin liquidity and Fed rate fears; a market bottom remains unconfirmed.

item.title: World Bank to Explore USDC Payments With Citi and Circle
item.description: The World Bank Group will assess regulated dollar stablecoins with Citi and Circle for development fund payments, starting with borrower countries where use is permitted.

item.title: How to Record Bitcoin Bridge Transfers With Basis Intact
item.description: How to record bitcoin bridge transfers for tax reporting: link both chain legs, log fees and fiat values, then apply your country’s disposal rule.

item.title: Lagarde urges common rules for Europe’s tokenized markets
item.description: Christine Lagarde says Europe needs common rules as tokenized markets grow, warning fragmented platforms could block settlement and weaken a single market.

item.title: What Happens After a DAO Proposal Passes a Timelock?
item.description: What happens after a DAO proposal passes? It becomes eligible for execution; quorum, a timelock and an authorized executor determine when the change takes effect.

item.title: Revoke approvals now or wait? Know which can wait
item.description: Revoke approvals now or wait for lower gas fees? Revoke risky spenders immediately; wait on reputable dormant approvals until a quiet fee window.

item.title: Why Did My renBTC Mint Need a Darknode Signature?
item.description: Why did a renBTC mint need a Darknode signature instead of a custodian? RenVM's nodes jointly authorized the mint, and the gateway contract checked their shared key.

item.title: MetaMask Bridge vs Polygon Portal: Pick Your First Route
item.description: MetaMask Bridge vs Polygon Portal for moving funds to Polygon: Portal suits most first transfers; choose MetaMask for native USDC or faster arrival.

item.title: How to Swap Tokens with a Ledger Connected to MetaMask on Ethereum
item.description: How to swap tokens with a Ledger connected to MetaMask: add the Ledger account, connect on Matcha swap, then approve and sign each Ethereum transaction on the device.
